patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,91 @@
+;; NOTE: Assertions have been generated by update_lit_checks.py --all-items and should not be edited.
+;; RUN: foreach %s %t wasm-opt --gsi -all --closed-world -S -o - | filecheck %s
+;; RUN: foreach %s %t wasm-opt --gsi-desc-cast -all --closed-world -S -o - | filecheck %s
+
+;; A struct.new in a table initializer or in an element segment creates an
+;; object that is not in a global, so a struct.get must not be replaced by a
+;; read of the globals.
+
+
+(module
+  ;; CHECK:      (type $U (struct (field i32) (field i64)))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (type $T (struct (field i32)))
+  (type $T (struct (field i32)))
+  (type $U (struct (field i32) (field i64)))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (type $2 (func (result i32)))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (global $g1 (ref $T) (struct.new $T
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i32.const 1)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: ))
+  (global $g1 (ref $T) (struct.new $T (i32.const 1)))
+  ;; CHECK:      (global $g2 (ref $T) (struct.new $T
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i32.const 2)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: ))
+  (global $g2 (ref $T) (struct.new $T (i32.const 2)))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (global $h1 (ref $U) (struct.new $U
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i32.const 3)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i64.const 0)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: ))
+  (global $h1 (ref $U) (struct.new $U (i32.const 3) (i64.const 0)))
+  ;; CHECK:      (global $h2 (ref $U) (struct.new $U
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i32.const 4)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i64.const 0)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: ))
+  (global $h2 (ref $U) (struct.new $U (i32.const 4) (i64.const 0)))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (table $t 1 1 (ref null $T) (struct.new $T
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i32.const 99)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: ))
+  (table $t 1 1 (ref null $T) (struct.new $T (i32.const 99)))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (table $u 1 1 (ref null $U))
+  (table $u 1 1 (ref null $U))
+  (elem (table $u) (i32.const 0) (ref null $U)
+    (item (struct.new $U (i32.const 98) (i64.const 0))))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (elem $0 (table $u) (i32.const 0) (ref null $U) (item (struct.new $U
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i32.const 98)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (i64.const 0)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: )))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (export "from-table-init" (func $from-table-init))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (export "from-elem" (func $from-elem))
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (func $from-table-init (type $2) (result i32)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (struct.get $T 0
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:   (ref.as_non_null
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:    (table.get $t
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:     (i32.const 0)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:    )
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:   )
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  )
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: )
+  (func $from-table-init (export "from-table-init") (result i32)
+    (struct.get $T 0
+      (ref.as_non_null
+        (table.get $t (i32.const 0))
+      )
+    )
+  )
+
+  ;; CHECK:      (func $from-elem (type $2) (result i32)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  (struct.get $U 0
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:   (ref.as_non_null
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:    (table.get $u
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:     (i32.const 0)
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:    )
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:   )
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT:  )
+  ;; CHECK-NEXT: )
+  (func $from-elem (export "from-elem") (result i32)
+    (struct.get $U 0
+      (ref.as_non_null
+        (table.get $u (i32.const 0))
+      )
+    )
+  )
+)
